title: Sportswear HO19 / Court Vision Lo white shoe layout

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Relate background accents to the product so the composition feels connected without hiding footwear detail.
strategic_value: Pink and blue surroundings can echo the white shoe’s colored branding while keeping the pale product prominent.
demonstration: A white Court Vision Lo shoe with blue Swoosh and pink tongue label sits in a taped frame over blue court imagery and a pink field.
practical_value: Compare product-linked color accents with the black-shoe variant in NS06.

content_islands.name: Footwear frame
content_islands.spec: Center the white-shoe close-up in a pale taped frame with the black product name below.

content_islands.name: Color collage
content_islands.spec: Layer blue court markings, a pink texture and smaller wearer photographs behind the frame.

content_islands.name: Campaign copy
content_islands.spec: Set the white headline and small explanatory sentence beneath the frame, followed by the Nike signature.

reference_purposes.Expression: A white Court Vision Lo shoe with blue Swoosh and pink tongue label sits in a taped frame over blue court imagery and a pink field.
